name: Barbell Walking Lunge
steps: Rest a barbell securely across your upper back, brace your core, and stand tall with an open lane ahead.
Step forward with one leg and bend both knees smoothly until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your front foot to stand up and bring your trailing leg directly forward into the next stride.
Continue alternating legs smoothly forward in a controlled rhythm until completing the lane or set.
tips: Keep your torso tall and front knee tracking squarely over your middle toes on every step.
Step slightly hip-width apart rather than on a tightrope to stay steady under the bar.
